component.name: Rufux
component.summary: Create bootable USB drives from Windows and Linux images

description.p: Rufux is a Rufus-style bootable USB creator for Linux. It writes Linux images in DD mode, builds Windows 10/11 installation drives (FAT32 with split WIM, or NTFS/exFAT with UEFI:NTFS), formats drives, checks them for bad blocks and counterfeit capacity, and can save a drive to an image file.
Fix the progress bar for images larger than 2 GiB.
